directed.boundary_or_failure: The check fails without the endpoint/no-crossing conditions and does not independently certify the locations of all zeros. The height trend is observational and finite-range.
directed.uncertainty: The displayed identity is corrupted in extraction and is therefore not reconstructed here. Its combinatorial role and boundary conditions, plus the direction of the occupancy drift, are explicit.

4. Discussion. Our statistical material suggests that the zeros of Z(t) are distrib-
uted among the Gram intervals according to some hitherto unknown probabilistic
law. E.g., the counts of the Gram blocks of lengths 3, 4, 5 and 6 of various types
seem to tend to a certain (discrete) convex distribution (cf. the percentages in Tables
2 and 3) which depends on the length of the Gram block. It would be interesting to
have a probabilistic model which could explain or at least support this phenomenon.

risk_spans.reason: Acknowledgments, hardware-repeat provenance, and division of labor support audit history but add no new mathematical mechanism.

spontaneous.spontaneous_reading: The finite verification is best treated as a reusable parameter A: it may strengthen the premises of downstream conditional results even though increasing A never turns a bounded computation into a proof of RH.

directed.source_grounded_mathematics: The source notes that several cited results assume a bound A below which all complex zeros have real part 1/2. Because the computation substantially increases such a verified bound, the authors suggest tracing its consequences but explicitly say they did not do so.
directed.conceptual_reading: A finite zero verification can serve as an interface lemma whose parameter is consumed by other theorems. This preserves the useful downstream role of computation while keeping it logically separate from an unbounded statement.
directed.representation_or_bridge: The predicate that all zeros below height A lie on the critical line is the bridge object connecting a computational certificate to literature results parameterized by A.
directed.boundary_or_failure: No particular downstream improvement is derived in this paper, and the finite statement does not prove the Riemann hypothesis. The cited consequences cannot be assessed from this unit.
directed.uncertainty: The extracted zeta symbol is corrupted, but the finite-height conditional statement and the authors' scope limitation are clear.
